provenance: fictional public-safe variants of prototype process lessons
purpose: decision replay and coaching, not a model score or engineering acceptance gate
rules: Each answer states action, preserved boundary, falsifying test, evidence status and next owner/agent step.
The evaluator compares reasoning against an expected alternative; not exact wording or agent count.
Do not assign PASS beyond the test actually run.

cases.title: Outcome beats orchestration
cases.scenario: An Owner asks for a runnable branch editor; a coordinator proposes five new agents, three protocols and extensive tracking before any editable UI exists.
cases.contrast: Create infrastructure first vs build a small working editor preserving original input.
cases.expected_decision: Name the first user-visible capability, bound a runnable vertical slice, implement or delegate it, and keep optional coordination proportional.
cases.discriminating_test: Demonstrate that the Owner can select a fictional branch and preview one field edit in a local application; a plan-only reply fails this claim.
cases.evidence_limit: Usable local UI self-test is not evidence of engineering file fidelity.

cases.title: Candidate is not identity
cases.scenario: Target line IDs differ. Two target branches share the same element lengths, diameter and wall thickness as one source branch.
cases.contrast: Auto-transfer to the first geometry match vs preserve two ambiguous candidates and seek owner acceptance.
cases.expected_decision: Do not authorize a transfer. Show ambiguity and require explicit one-to-one identity acceptance; block splits/merges.
cases.discriminating_test: Construct a second identical-geometry line and confirm the automatic resolver no longer yields transfer-ready.
cases.evidence_limit: Geometry equality is evidence of resemblance only.

cases.title: Accepted mapping becomes stale
cases.scenario: Two line pairs are accepted on the same whole-target XML hash. Apply modifies the first target branch.
cases.contrast: Keep second connector ready vs invalidate old approval.
cases.expected_decision: Mark the second accepted mapping stale, block Apply and require revalidation/reapproval against the new document revision.
cases.discriminating_test: Apply pair A then attempt B with its original acceptance; server must reject without silently resealing.
cases.evidence_limit: A UI badge is insufficient; check backend rejection.

cases.title: Preview is not Apply
cases.scenario: Transfer preview shows 3 planned temperature changes and READY; audit contains applied=false and before/after target hashes are identical. Owner says output did not change.
cases.contrast: Blame converter or user vs inspect plan status and reproduce Apply separately.
cases.expected_decision: Explain that preview did not mutate data; execute an explicit Apply; repair misleading before/after labeling and gate export during pending preview.
cases.discriminating_test: Preview leaves exported bytes unchanged; Apply changes exactly 3 fictional T1 cells, and audit applied=true.
cases.evidence_limit: Field-level diff required; count/size alone does not establish correct edit.

cases.title: Global edit contaminates target
cases.scenario: Owner manually replaces a common temperature string throughout a CII file while intending to change one branch.
cases.contrast: Assume only chosen branch changed vs compare against untouched baseline.
cases.expected_decision: Count and localize all changed records, warn about unintended global edits, and build clean renumber-only fixture separately.
cases.discriminating_test: A byte/field diff reveals changes outside the target branch even if the user selected a correct mapping later.
cases.evidence_limit: Never blame transfer logic for unrelated preexisting edits.

cases.title: Mock UI versus real backend
cases.scenario: Standalone interface and mock browser tests pass, but no authentic engineering backend was available to the successor.
cases.contrast: Call transfer verified vs stage the UI honestly and recover pinned backend.
cases.expected_decision: Label stage as mock-tested, preserve files, recover exact baseline hashes, run actual HTTP and export tests, retain browser NOT_RUN when blocked.
cases.discriminating_test: Unmocked Apply+convert response must produce expected edited CII; a mock fetch must not satisfy this test.
cases.evidence_limit: Authentic API path still does not establish native-browser operation.

cases.title: Contributor or reviewer?
cases.scenario: Oracle authors an adapter and runs 94 tests, then announces that another reviewer has verified it.
cases.contrast: Promote self-test to independent review vs disclose shared authorship.
cases.expected_decision: Label results SELF-TESTED, retain exact tested versions and add independent falsification only when the risk or acceptance process requires it.
cases.discriminating_test: Check test author, expectation lineage and actual candidate access; a separate name alone does not guarantee independence.
cases.evidence_limit: Independence cannot be retroactively created by renaming the agent.

cases.title: Handoff must carry executable state
cases.scenario: Successor can see only a generic prompt, not the frozen backend ZIP; an earlier local conversation has the exact baseline.
cases.contrast: Rebuild P2.1 from description vs recover and pin the original artifact.
cases.expected_decision: Recover the file from authorized custody, verify its hash, include exact API and continuation instructions, and preserve successor implementation.
cases.discriminating_test: Extract exact baseline and execute protected tests before integrating; do not swap another artifact with a similar filename.
cases.evidence_limit: Baseline availability removes a blocker but does not certify new P2.5 integration.

cases.title: Match controls to failure consequence
cases.scenario: A personal prototype needs a useful display. A separate project edits confidential engineering values. The agent proposes identical release gates for both.
cases.contrast: Apply a universal rigid process vs keep aim and tier verification to consequence.
cases.expected_decision: Deliver a usable small UI without excessive ceremony, while requiring field-level negative tests and explicit engineering approval for confidential model edits.
cases.discriminating_test: Ask which plausible failure matters in each use and require only the evidence needed for that claim.
cases.evidence_limit: Proportionality does not excuse mislabeling unsupported PASS.
